svg.title: The public boundary of DorkOS Cloud
svg.desc: Optional local Cloud clients use HTTPS. Legacy app-side paths coexist with the versioned public contract. The versioned client resolves authenticated instance identity before minting scoped inference credentials under the same current link. Claude Code may use the returned inference endpoint when explicitly enabled. The existing tunnel is a separate route to the local server.
